SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID 
WHERE e.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND p.SEX = 'F' 
  AND e.`Examination Date` LIKE '1997%'

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`Examination Date`, e.Thrombosis 
FROM Patient p 
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID 
WHERE e.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND p.SEX = 'F' 
  AND e.`Examination Date` LIKE '1997%'
